scope: RTL8822CE runtime TXBD debug ON/OFF, existing module; patched module compiled but not installed

measurement.oracle: NONE for performance; complete workload, unchanged mode and no PMU multiplexing checked as invariants
measurement.cycles: All online CPUs, user and kernel included, hypervisor excluded; no multiplexing
measurement.active_seconds_estimate: sum(cpu_cycles / (that_cpu_frequency_khz * 1000)); frequency checked before and after each run, not packet latency
measurement.window_end: Sender returns only after application receiver confirms all 16000 unique datagrams; does not prove all local completion work has drained

exploratory_measurement.reason: Window ended at sender sendto completion and could omit remote delivery tail; all samples retained

limitations: System-wide PMU observation includes unrelated activity and link retry variation
Fixed ABBA samples are descriptive, not independent random samples or a confidence interval
Per-datagram normalization refers to UDP application datagrams, not 802.11 fragments or hardware retries
Runtime OFF retains code, conditional branches and static buffers; compiled-out module performance and maximum throughput were not measured
